intro: The Alpine recliner is our invitation to unwind. With a soft, floating seat feel, smooth manual reclining, and high back support, it wraps your body in comfort and your mind in stillness.

features.title: Your comfort, your control—times two
features.text: The manual reclining system on both ends means you and your loved one can each find your own perfect angle—no compromise, just comfort that moves with you, exactly how you like it.

features.title: Support that helps you reset
features.text: Our high backrest with cushioned head support is made to support you where it matters most. It holds your posture gently so you can unwind without effort, anytime you take a seat.

features.title: Comfort you’ll want to share
features.text: From the soft seats to the plush arms, we’ve used premium foam and fibre fill throughout. So when it’s time to relax together, you’ll all feel weightless, supported and welcome.

features.title: Tough where it needs to be
features.text: Our synthetic leather upholstery resists daily wear, scratches and peeling—so no matter how much time you spend lounging, your sofa stays beautiful with very little effort.

features.title: Cushioned in all the right places
features.text: Whether you're reading, watching or just resting, your back and arms are in good hands. Thoughtful lumbar padding and overfilled armrests keep every part of you deeply relaxed.

name: Alpine 3-Seater Synthetic Leather Recliner Manual Sofa
